title: Operational surface convergence
invariants: Home remains decision-first, keeps a bounded priority worklist after the primary decision and does not restore a numeric dashboard.
RN-01 exposes source/material intake before monitoring registry controls.
RN-01 monitoring records are collapsible and filterable without changing business providers.
EC-01 exposes a filterable event registry and terminal records do not request formulation verification.
AO-01 keeps stable record identifiers and existing fail-closed activation prerequisites.
MC-01 has one visible Comprendi standard entry per framework card.
MC-01 retires the duplicate visible finetune concept drilldown.
Scope editing becomes an overlay without changing the existing standards scope route.
The standard browser is read-only and uses node-specific content when available, otherwise explicit absence instead of generic filler.
User role can inspect a standard but cannot see the administrator scope editor.
The new presentation layer owns no independent palette tokens or business-state mutation API.
A6-UX1 fixed-safe footer and A6-UX2 chrome owners remain untouched.
claimBoundary: Repository-owned operational composition only. Parent S4-A6 remains open. No enterprise-candidate, enterprise-ready, human usability, accessibility certification, deployment effectiveness, independent assurance or legal/compliance claim is created.
